title: Canarian cave home with a mountain-facing terrace
why_great: White cave walls, a planted terrace and rugged mountain views in Barranco Hondo. The advertiser describes a well-maintained, furnished home with two bedrooms and one bathroom, ready to use without renovation. Several rooms open directly onto the terrace. Access is on foot: cars cannot reach the house, and parking is approximately 50 metres away.
pick_note: Selected for its mountain-facing garden terrace and traditional white cave architecture.
verified_note: Asking price and photographs checked against the live advertiser listing on 2 October 2026. Seller confirmation and an on-site inspection are still pending.

title: A white cave house perched above Galera
why_great: A whitewashed cave home set into the hillside above historic Galera, with a terrace overlooking the village and surrounding countryside. The listing describes two double bedrooms, a fitted kitchen, a living room with fireplace and one bathroom, all in good condition. Parking is nearby. The advertiser does not provide a reliable internal floor area, so none is shown here.
pick_note: Selected for its striking hillside setting, white facade and village panorama.

title: A stone dining terrace above the Andarax valley
why_great: A rustic stone terrace with outdoor dining and views towards the Andarax valley is the highlight of this furnished cave home in Terque's Al-Kamar area. The listing includes two bedrooms, one bathroom and an open living area with a fireplace, and describes it as ready to move into. It is inland, with the coast approximately 30 km away. Interiors retain traditional, modest finishes.
pick_note: Selected for its sunny stone terrace, mountain outlook and whitewashed exterior.

title: A white village home with a Sierra de Baza roof terrace
why_great: A sunny roof terrace looks across the green valley towards the Sierra de Baza. This two-storey home combines conventional rooms with cave rooms extending through the hillside, with entrances on both sides. The listing describes four bedrooms, three bathrooms, fireplaces and a carport, and says it is ready to move into. Interiors are traditional rather than recently styled. Baza is around 15 minutes away by car.
pick_note: Selected for its roof terrace, open mountain view and white village facade.
